purpose: Route selected enquiry fields to an external system after submission.
audience: Safari leads and internal sales team

field_settings.dynamic_population: Source campaign may be populated by approved block field values or query string parameter with non-sensitive values only.

conditional_logic: Webhook feed runs only when Enquiry type is supported by the external system.
Source campaign must not contain personal data.
confirmations: Show a standard thank-you message regardless of webhook status unless a tested synchronous error flow is approved.
notifications: Send admin notification as fallback even when webhook is configured.
feeds: Webhooks Add-On feed using selected fields only; never All Fields by default.

spam_settings.recommended: Spam protection must remain enabled before external feeds run.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels required for all user-facing fields.
accessibility_settings.errors: Webhook failures should not create confusing frontend validation unless intentionally designed.

embedding_target: Enquiry page or campaign landing page after embed validation.
data_retention_notes: Includes consent to process the enquiry. External-system retention must be recorded separately.

test_data.normal_case: Private guideed enquiry type with source campaign value.
test_data.skip_case: Unsupported enquiry type should skip webhook condition.

risks: Webhook can disclose personal data externally.
Endpoint secrets must never be stored in the skill package or user-facing output.
